### The Masquerade Night

The ballroom was a [magnificent]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="magnificent · adj. 壮丽的, 伟大的, 华丽的, 高贵的"} [spectacle]{.vocab tabindex="0" data-def="spectacle · n. 壮观的场面或景象; 可笑的事物; 愚蠢的景象; 眼镜"}.
